name: Ron's Home Style Foods

about:
Ron's Home Style Foods was founded in the spring of 1985 by Ron Woodall in Houston, Texas. The family-owned company began with a mission to produce high-quality, home-style deli salads that look and taste homemade. Woodall had previously developed the successful Ron's Krispy Fried Chicken chain before launching the venture.

Today the company operates a USDA- and FDA-inspected production facility where it makes deli salads, dips and spreads, dressings and bases, gourmet burger kits, frozen sides and entrees, and provides co-packing and private-label services. Products are prepared fresh daily using high-quality ingredients, and the facility is described as exceeding food-safety expectations.

Ron's serves the foodservice and grocery channels nationwide. Its retail line, Texas Kitchen, is stocked in major Texas chains including Brookshire Brothers, H-E-B, and Kroger. The company also partners with foodservice distributors and recently announced a collaboration with Center of the Plate Foods Sales to accelerate national growth.

The business emphasizes a homemade look and taste, with attention to detail that extends beyond what can be seen and tasted. Its founding goal remains the benchmark: delivering products that meet global food-safety standards while satisfying customer expectations for quality and consistency.
